/events/reggae-ambassadors-pickering-202.title: Reggae Ambassadors Day Rave — Pickering 11 OCT 2026 | Kings of Kings International
/events/reggae-ambassadors-pickering-202.description: An afternoon and evening of live reggae at Aquário Beach Club, presented by Kings of Kings International and Farex Entertainment. The lineup featured Marcia Griffiths, Turbulence, Jah Mason, Iley Dread and Angie Angel.

/events/reggae-ambassadors-niagara-2026/.title: Reggae Ambassadors in Concert — Niagara Falls 10 OCT 2026 | Kings of Kings International
/events/reggae-ambassadors-niagara-2026/.description: The Reggae Ambassadors concert brought Marcia Griffiths and a lineup of reggae performers to The Columbus Room in Niagara Falls.

/events/reggae-ambassadors-toronto-2026/.title: Reggae Ambassadors in Concert — Toronto 09 OCT 2026 | Kings of Kings International
/events/reggae-ambassadors-toronto-2026/.description: Sister Nancy joined Turbulence, Jah Mason, Iley Dread and Angie Angel for the Toronto Reggae Ambassadors concert at Phoenix Concert Theatre.

/events/unleashed-toronto-2016/.title: Unleashed — Record Release & Showcase — Toronto 01 MAY 2016 | Kings of Kings International
/events/unleashed-toronto-2016/.description: The Toronto Record Release & Showcase at The Opera House featured Colin Levy / Iley Chardavid alongside Judy Mowatt, Exco Levi, Chrisinti, Leroy Gibbons, Jah Cutta, Fire Lion and Mikey Dangerous, as listed on the original flyer.

/events/unleashed-montreal-2016/.title: Unleashed — Montréal Showcase — Montréal 30 APR 2016 | Kings of Kings International

/events/1000-degrees-2018/.title: 1000 Degrees of Sweet — Toronto 07 OCT 2018 | Kings of Kings International
/events/1000-degrees-2018/.description: The October 7, 2018 flyer features Cocoa Tea, Louie Culture, Len Hammond, Japanese Fyanese, Jah Cutta and Chelsea Stewart. The artwork identifies a cancer-survivor fundraiser and the Step by Step Band.

/events/sizzla-rise-to-the-occasion-2026.title: Sizzla Youth Foundation — Rise to the Occasion — Scarborough 30 AUG 2026 | Kings of Kings International
/events/sizzla-rise-to-the-occasion-2026.description: The live site advertised the second annual Sizzla Youth Foundation fireside chat and community conversation, supporting the foundation and Urban Rez Community Mobile Unit.

/events/31st-anniversary-montreal-2026/.title: Kings of Kings 31st Anniversary — Montréal — Montréal 29 MAY 2026 | Kings of Kings International
/events/31st-anniversary-montreal-2026/.description: The 31st anniversary celebration connected sound system culture with an Iley Dread album launch. The original listing names Tony Matterhorn, Iley Dread and Stone Love.

/events/31st-anniversary-toronto-2026/.title: Kings of Kings 31st Anniversary — Toronto — Toronto 30 MAY 2026 | Kings of Kings International
/events/31st-anniversary-toronto-2026/.description: The 31st anniversary celebration connected sound system culture with an Iley Dread album launch. The original listing names Tony Matterhorn, Iley Dread and Stone Love.

/events/rub-a-dub-live-2025/.title: Rub-A-Dub Live — Dinner & Dance — Toronto 08 NOV 2025 | Kings of Kings International

/events/icho-candy-toronto-2025/.title: Icho Candy Live in Toronto — Toronto 07 NOV 2025 | Kings of Kings International

/events/reggae-r-us-2025/.title: Reggae R Us Festival — Etobicoke 26 JUL 2025 | Kings of Kings International
